about: scipy.signal.butter for every design asked for while the flute_vs_trombone soundtrack is built (kit.music.main) and its band and loudness checks run

notes.Wn: the cutoff(s) as float.hex(): one for a low- or high-pass, two for a band-pass; in Hz when fs is given, else as a fraction of the Nyquist frequency (the Pixel Pitch series passes f / (44100 / 2))
notes.btype: as the caller wrote it: 'hp', 'lp', 'bp' (reelkit.audio.sos) or 'high', 'low', 'band'
notes.requests: how many times the design was asked for
notes.sos: output "sos": float64 (sections, 6), each row b0 b1 b2 a0 a1 a2, as scipy orders the sections
notes.used_by: the kit functions that asked (module, then function)
